errors.text: The proposed optimum of 920 °C directly contradicts the target result that SPS at 1000 °C provides the best density, hardness, oxidation resistance, and corrosion resistance.
The hypothesis incorrectly treats 1000 °C as causing Mg-loss porosity and phase segregation, whereas it is the demonstrated optimum within the allowed window.

The asserted transient Mg–transition-metal eutectic liquid phase is unspecified and unsupported by the cited evidence; none of the references demonstrates such liquid-phase sintering in the proposed Mg–Ti/Zr/Nb system.
The material composition is not reconstructed: the target is ball-milled MgAlTiVFeCo powder initially forming a simple BCC phase.
The proposed single-phase retention mechanism misses the target mediator of uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases, including AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3.
The functional validation omits corrosion testing in 3.5 wt% NaCl and uses oxidation at 600 °C rather than the target 900 °C.
The claimed density above 98% and degradation at 1000 °C are unsupported and conflict with the measured target density of 96.7% at 1000 °C.
